text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan run
with fierce tenacity.
Refusing to be outdone by 
their spirit, Yaeno Muteki displays an 
unprecedented fighting drive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The result was a 1st-place finish for 
Sakura Chiyono O. Yaeno Muteki expressed 
her gratitude,
noting that she was able to 
run well because she was pushed by the 
sheer tenacity of the other two.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Yaeno Muteki informed the 
Trainer:
Though she had given it her best, 
she had nearly lost control. A lingering 
anxiety remained for the future...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then let us hone the perfection of "Unity 
of Fire and Water," proposed the Trainer. 
Yaeno Muteki agreed, stating she had been 
thinking the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Indeed,
she was pumped up for the upcoming 
Kikuka Sho—however,
word soon arrived that 
both Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan 
would be sitting out the race due to 
injuries.
